blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The SM Seaside Cebu Arena has been declared safe following inspections and cleanup activities conducted after loose debris from above its acoustic ceiling fell onto the performance area. Cebu City government officials and representatives of the arena management presented the findings during a press conference on Saturday, November 21, 2026, assuring the public that the venue remains safe to host events.
